scope: distributed Worker database, packages, events, PKI issuer and Gateway

mutations.when: startup and every read_conn/write_txn through ensure_ready
mutations.operation: chown(shared gid), chmod directories 02770 and DB files 0660
mutations.requires_privilege: adding SGID is forbidden by RestrictSUIDSGID even for owner; chown may also require privilege
mutations.replacement_boundary: privileged path-scoped bootstrap establishes directory owner/group/SGID/ACL; startup and request-time code validate

mutations.when: lazy request access and service startup
mutations.operation: mkdir static state directories; open/migrate SQLite
mutations.requires_privilege: shared directory creation requires deployment ownership model
mutations.replacement_boundary: shared mode requires bootstrap-created static directories and validates before serving; private mode retains caller-owned creation
SGID/default ACL provide gid; creator may complete safe owner-controlled 0660 mode; wrong gid or unsafe bits fail closed

mutations.operation: mkdir runtime socket parent 0750, unlink stale socket, chmod socket 0660
mutations.replacement_boundary: unchanged ephemeral RuntimeDirectory boundary; not persistent shared state

mutations.operation: create PKI directories and write/chown/chmod keys/certificates
mutations.replacement_boundary: unchanged explicit operator boundary; never called by request path

mutations.operation: mkdir, temporary write, atomic replace, remove chunk tree
mutations.replacement_boundary: inherits bootstrap SGID/default ACL; ordinary data mutation remains runtime-owned

mutations.operation: mkdir staging, create archives/files, chmod extracted payload 0644, atomic replace, cleanup
mutations.replacement_boundary: ordinary payload mutation; static parent prepared by bootstrap; no directory SGID repair

mutations.operation: mkdir parent, temp archive write, atomic replace, manifest write
mutations.replacement_boundary: ordinary payload mutation under prepared source_packages parent
ordinary data mutation under prepared event_logs parent

mutations.operation: mkdir, atomic archive move, report/manifest writes
mutations.replacement_boundary: ordinary data mutation under prepared result_packages parent

mutations.operation: staging/backup mkdir, copy, replace, unlink and rollback
mutations.replacement_boundary: project/result data transaction, not permission normalization

mutations.operation: UMask and RuntimeDirectory creation by systemd

primary_defect: database.ensure_ready reaches unconditional chmod(02770) from every database-backed Worker request
target: fail startup on invalid shared-state metadata; no request-time directory chmod/chown
